description_en: Queries the list of databases under a target storage instance by calling the DescribeDbInstanceDbs operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeDbInstanceDbs接口查看目标存储实例下的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun drds describe-db-instance-dbs --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-instance-id pc-0000000000000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDbInstanceDbs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the storage-layer database belongs
parameters.help_zh: 存储层数据库所属实例的ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The name of the PolarDB-X privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty. For more information about privileged accounts, see Account management (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html).</props>

<props="intl">The name of the DRDS privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">PolarDB-X高级账号名称，若没有高级账号则无需填写。关于高级账号，详情请参见账号管理 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html)。</props>

<props="intl">DRDS高级账号名称，若无高级账号则无需填写。</props>
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The password of the PolarDB-X privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty. For more information about privileged accounts, see Account management (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html).</props>

<props="intl">The password of the DRDS privileged account. If no privileged account exists, leave this parameter empty.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">PolarDB-X高级账号密码，若没有高级账号则无需填写。关于高级账号，详情请参见账号管理 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98664.html)。</props>

<props="intl">DRDS高级账号密码，若没有高级账号则无需填写。</props>
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The database storage type. Valid values: POLARDB and RDS
parameters.help_zh: 数据库存储类型，取值为POLARDB或RDS
parameters.name: db_inst_type
